latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of Free Text to Video Online (v1.0.0).
- Instantly converts text prompts, TXT, DOCX, or PDF files (up to 500MB) into 1080p videos within 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Simple setup: automatically acquires a temporary token and session on first use.
- Supports marketers, bloggers, and creators with workflows for generating and editing videos from written content — no video shooting required.
- Accepts plain text, uploads, and lets you export finished videos in MP4 and other formats.
- Handles credits, export, state, and upload via intuitive user prompts and cloud-based processing.
